summary: Lightspeed Commerce Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, announcing its Annual and Special Meeting of Security Holders scheduled for July 30, 2026, with a record date of June 1, 2026. The filing also includes the appointment of Bhawna Singh as Chief Technology Officer. This is a routine administrative announcement with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, notifying exchanges of meeting details and an executive hire. No deal terms, premium, or regulatory catalysts are present, and no risk-arb angle applies.
